findings.finding_id: records/specs/2026-10-31-FAFF-1416-faff-pr-open-move-graft-s-step-9b-pr-opening-from-prose-into-a-command-design.md::spec scenarios use an issue id pr-body refuses (x-1)
findings.title: spec scenarios use an issue id pr-body refuses (X-1)
findings.action: Amend the scenarios to a two-character prefix before the holdout runs.
findings.disposition_rationale: A spec defect, not a code one: pr-body's target pattern (unchanged, out of scope) needs two characters before the dash, so X-1 refuses at the sanitize step. The code follows the spec; the CLI-level tests run the same scenarios with TT-1. Reported for the operator to amend before the holdout.

occurrences.title: spec scenarios use an issue id pr-body refuses (X-1)

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/validate-adapters.js::step 9b lint's invokes-pr-open check satisfied by a prose mention
findings.title: Step 9b lint's invokes-pr-open check satisfied by a prose mention
findings.disposition_rationale: Correct: the quoted "$faff" pr open form did not match. The call now has to carry flags (faff"?\s+pr\s+open\s+--) and the direct-call patterns accept the quoted form; tests add a mention-only Step 9b that fails and a fenced shell call that passes (commit 8c5f1eb0).

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/pr-open.ts::pr open derives grant inputs with repo null
findings.title: pr open derives grant inputs with repo null
findings.disposition_rationale: resolveAnchorLevel reads the anchor with git show at the head first and uses the repo slug only as the contents-API fallback; pr open derives at the local HEAD it has just committed and pushed, so git show always succeeds and the slug is never consulted. No PR (and so no PR url) exists yet at that step.

occurrences.title: pr open derives grant inputs with repo null

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/pr-open.ts::toctou between the existing-pr lookup and pr-create
findings.title: TOCTOU between the existing-PR lookup and pr-create
findings.disposition_rationale: gh pr create itself refuses when an open PR for the head already targets the base, so a PR opened in the window makes faff pr-create return refuse and pr open returns refused / pr-create-refused; no second PR opens.

occurrences.title: TOCTOU between the existing-PR lookup and pr-create

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/pr-open.ts::late no-op from pr-create after the anchor push
findings.title: late no-op from pr-create after the anchor push
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec step 16 maps pr-create's no-op to no-op explicitly. It needs a remote that existed at step 2 and accepted the push to vanish before step 16; kept as specced rather than inventing a token.
